questions.question: शतपथब्राह्मणस्य प्राधां िनणयत। Evaluate the importance of Shathapathabrahmana .
questions.solution_html:
• The ŚatapathaBrāhmaṇa is considered as the most important text ,next to the
  • Rigvedasamhita - attached to the Śukla Yajurveda.-Narrates stories such as the Deluge myth
  • of Manu, linking ritual with mythic imagination.-story of Urvasi and Pururuvas-mentions
  • story of Janamejaya and gives geographical data pertaining to the spread of Brahmanical
  • system to the various part of india –The concluding chapter constitutes
  • Brihadaranyakopanishad one of the most important of the Upanishads .
questions.final_answer: Brihadaranyakopanishad one of the most important of the Upanishads

questions.solution_html:
• The Vedangas are six auxiliary disciplines that support the proper understanding and
  • practice of the Vedas: siksha ,KalpaVyakarana , Nirukta, Chandas, Jyotiṣa.-science of
  • phonetics and pronunciation. -deals with letters,accents,quantity pronunciation ,and euphonic
  • rules - Ensures purity of transmission of Vedic hymns in oral tradition.- Without Śikṣā, the
  • meaning of mantras could be distorted, leading to loss of sanctity.Some of the prominent
  • Siksha works-Paniniyasiksha, Yanjyavalkyasiksha, Naradasiksha,VasishtiSiksha
  • ,KathyayaniSiksha ,gowthameesiksha .
  • 19Chandaśāstra is the ancient science of poetic metres. It studies the arrangement of
  • syllables (akṣara)and (mātrā) to create rhythm in verse.- one of the six Vedāṅgas-deals with
  • the metrical patterns used in poetry and Vedic hymns.-earliest systematic text is
  • Piṅgala’sChandaḥśāstra-The Brihatsamhita of Varahamihira contains a chapter on meters –
  • most popular treatise on classical meters Vrittaratnakara of Kedarabhatta .
